why.text: Castrol is BP's lubricants brand; bp has agreed to sell 65% of it to Stonepeak. In 2013 a US court accepted the guilty plea of BP Exploration and Production, the bp company that was lease operator of the block where the Deepwater Horizon rig exploded in 2010, to 11 counts of felony manslaughter. BP admitted that its two highest-ranking supervisors on the rig negligently caused the deaths of 11 men.
why.messageLine: In 2013 BP, Castrol's owner, pleaded guilty to 11 counts of felony manslaughter over the 2010 Deepwater Horizon disaster, admitting its supervisors negligently caused the deaths of 11 men.
